storyParagraphs: NextGrades started in 2021 as a passion project — born from frustration with outdated tutoring methods and a belief that every student deserves better.
What began as helping a few friends quickly grew into a platform trusted by hundreds of students across Germany. We combine live tutoring with structured digital content.
Today we are building the learning experience we always wished existed: personal, professional, and designed for real life.
